title: Monitoring and improving the FMT placement with video analysis and ABR recording
summary:
Hearing improvement with the VSB is highly dependent on the coupler and the coupling efficiency between the FMT and the middle ear structures. Intraoperative Auditory Brainsteam Resonses measured via the VSB during implantation with the new AcoustiAP tool and standard IA Eclipse system has been recently described.
We intend to monitor and improve the choice of the coupler and the critical coupling process in 15 patients by testing at least two different, however both promising, couplers in every patient and compare the ABRrecording and video analysis on site. Additional measurements after wound closure with the same equipment is intended. Vibrogram and bone conduction measurements are planned for the day after operation and 3, 6 and 12 months after first fitting.
An intra-operative analysis of at least two different coupling modalities as well as a intra- and postoperative analysis is designed.

interventions.name:
A pure tone audiogram is performed before and after the operation.
